labels.name: uploadcare_list_groups
labels.description: List file groups in the project (paginated envelope: next, previous, total, per_page, results). REST API: GET /groups/.

labels.name: uploadcare_get_group
labels.description: Get info for a single file group by its id. REST API: GET /groups/{uuid}/.

labels.name: uploadcare_list_webhooks
labels.description: List all webhook subscriptions configured for the project. REST API: GET /webhooks/.

labels.name: uploadcare_upload_from_url
labels.description: Uploads a file into the project from a public URL (additive). Uses the Upload API host with the public key. Returns { type: "token", token } for async ingestion (poll separately) or the file info. Upload API: POST /from_url/.

labels.name: uploadcare_store_file
labels.description: Marks a file as permanently stored (otherwise unstored files are deleted after 24h). Additive. REST API: PUT /files/{uuid}/storage/.

labels.name: uploadcare_delete_file
labels.description: Permanently deletes a file from the project. Destructive. REST API: DELETE /files/{uuid}/.

labels.name: uploadcare_create_webhook
labels.description: Creates a webhook subscription (additive). The project will POST to target_url when the chosen event fires. REST API: POST /webhooks/.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: uploadcare_get_file · Private data: uploadcare_list_files, uploadcare_get_file, uploadcare_get_file_metadata, uploadcare_list_groups, uploadcare_get_group, uploadcare_upload_from_url, uploadcare_store_file, uploadcare_delete_file · Public sink: uploadcare_list_webhooks, uploadcare_upload_from_url, uploadcare_create_webhook · Destructive: uploadcare_delete_file.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: uploadcare_get_file · Private data: uploadcare_list_files, uploadcare_get_file, uploadcare_get_file_metadata, uploadcare_list_groups, uploadcare_get_group, uploadcare_upload_from_url, uploadcare_store_file, uploadcare_delete_file · Public sink: uploadcare_list_webhooks, uploadcare_upload_from_url, uploadcare_create_webhook · Destructive: uploadcare_delete_file

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
